summary: Solid edge-first design that cleanly separates a read-heavy redirect data plane from a strongly consistent control plane, using Postgres constraints plus an outbox to converge an edge KV read model. It is broadly production-ready for very high redirect QPS with sensible enforcement (state/expiry) and a fast takedown path, though some critical scaling and multi-region details are underspecified.
strengths: Clear data-plane/control-plane split with edge KV read model, strong alias uniqueness via Postgres constraints, and reliable outbox-based propagation.
Thoughtful operational concerns: rapid takedown override key, versioning/If-Match, idempotency, rate limiting, and good observability targets/metrics.
weaknesses: Analytics ingestion via the main Link API is risky at 5–10B clicks/day without a dedicated ingestion pipeline/queue and explicit backpressure/drop semantics; it may become the dominant cost/availability coupling point.

Missing concrete multi-region Postgres strategy (leader/failover, write locality, RPO/RTO), plus edge KV provider limits/consistency semantics and propagation SLOs beyond “minutes/<60s” for worst-case global enforcement.
